Ui.Script:
-- A server's own menu (OctoWoW's: a Shop rung, Sound folded into a settings window of its -- own behind the UI Options rung) stays exactly as the server built it, its Options rung -- included; our window is `/benilla`. The stock menu takes the era reshape below. local serverMenu = GameMenuButtonSoundOptions == nil if serverMenu then SLASH_BENILLA_OPTIONS1 = "/benilla" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_OPTIONS"] = function() HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end -- Our window's rung, under the server's Options rung and above Key Bindings, which -- hangs 1 under it as under the rung it replaces; the frame grows by the rung. local ours = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSettings", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") ours:SetText("Benilla Settings") ours:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonUIOptions, "BOTTOM", 0, -1) ours:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end) GameMenuButtonKeybindings:ClearAllPoints() GameMenuButtonKeybindings:SetPoint("TOP", ours, "BOTTOM", 0, -1) GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(GameMenuFrame:GetHeight() + ours:GetHeight() + 1)
-- Addons add rungs of their own (pfUI's AddOns, ShaguTweaks, MoveAnything) and each -- places them against the layout it expects, which a server's menu is not, so they -- overlap. At every show, every shown rung is restacked in the order they stand: 1 -- apart within a group, 16 between groups (an addon's gap of more than 8 is a group -- break, an overlap is none), the first 32 under the top, and the frame fitted with -- its bottom pad kept. local function BenillaGameMenu_Restack() local rungs = {} for _, child in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetChildren() }) do if child:IsObjectType("Button") and child:IsShown() and child:GetTop() then table.insert(rungs, child) end end if table.getn(rungs) == 0 then return end table.sort(rungs, function(a, b) return a:GetTop() > b:GetTop() end) local last = rungs[table.getn(rungs)] local pad = (last:GetBottom() or 0) - (GameMenuFrame:GetBottom() or 0) if pad < 10 or pad > 40 then pad = 20 end local gaps = { 0 } for i = 2, table.getn(rungs) do local gap = rungs[i - 1]:GetBottom() - rungs[i]:GetTop() gaps[i] = (gap > 8) and 16 or 1 end local height = 32 + pad for i, rung in ipairs(rungs) do rung:ClearAllPoints() if i == 1 then rung:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32) else rung:SetPoint("TOP", rungs[i - 1], "BOTTOM", 0, -gaps[i]) end height = height + rung:GetHeight() + gaps[i] end GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(height) end local Ref_ServerMenu_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow") GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() if Ref_ServerMenu_OnShow then Ref_ServerMenu_OnShow() end BenillaGameMenu_Restack() end) else -- ══ The frame: the era layout, 28+144+28 wide, 32 top, 28 bottom, 7 rungs of 21 and -- three gaps of 20 ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ GameMenuFrame:SetWidth(200) GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(267)
-- The stock title (`GameMenuFrame.xml:36`) has no name: found as addons find it. for _, region in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetRegions() }) do if region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" and region:GetText() == MAIN_MENU then region:SetFontObject(BenillaGameFontNormalMed1) end end
-- BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE (OptionsFrame.xml) stands in for the era's UIParent scale; -- read at every show, then the stock OnShow. local Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow") GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() this:SetScale(BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE or 1) Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow() end)
-- ══ The rungs ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -- Every stock rung stays, anchored TOP to a BOTTOM as in the stock file, so an addon's -- `SetPoint("TOP", …)` replaces its one anchor. The three the era menu lacks are hidden -- in place, with Sound and UI Options each laid over the rung above it, so they take no -- space: a width or height of 0 is no size in 1.12's layout, not a flat rect.
-- Literal: 1.12 has no GAMEMENU_OPTIONS; its OPTIONS_MENU is "Options Menu". GameMenuButtonOptions:SetText("Options") GameMenuButtonOptions:ClearAllPoints() GameMenuButtonOptions:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32) GameMenuButtonOptions:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end)
for _, fold in ipairs({ { GameMenuButtonSoundOptions, GameMenuButtonOptions }, { GameMenuButtonUIOptions, GameMenuButtonSoundOptions }, }) do local button, above = fold[1], fold[2] button:Hide() button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("TOP", above, "BOTTOM", 0, button:GetHeight()) end -- Key Bindings keeps its stock anchor, 1 under UI Options: the era rungs hang from its -- top, so an addon that inserts a button above it and re-anchors it under that button -- (ShaguTweaks) moves them down as it moves the stock rungs. GameMenuButtonKeybindings:Hide()
-- The era's Edit Mode, with nothing behind it yet: disabled. local editMode = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonEditMode", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") editMode:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonKeybindings, "TOP", 0, -19) editMode:SetText("Edit Mode") editMode:Disable() local support = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSupport", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") support:SetPoint("TOP", editMode, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) support:SetText("Support") -- The era's Support opens the help window, which 1.12 opens from its "?" micro button -- (`MainMenuBarMicroButtons.xml:217`); closing the menu first, as the Macros rung does. support:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ToggleHelpFrame() end)
GameMenuButtonMacros:SetPoint("TOP", support, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonLogout:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonMacros, "BOTTOM", 0, -20) GameMenuButtonQuit:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonLogout, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonContinue:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonQuit, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)
end
-- ══ Our options window in the stock "is an options window open?" checks ═══════════════ -- Each wraps the stock function to add `BenillaOptionsFrame`. local Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen = IsOptionFrameOpen local Ref_ToggleGameMenu = ToggleGameMenu local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons
-- Guarded for a test kit that loads the game menu without the options window. local function BenillaOptions_IsOpen() return BenillaOptionsFrame and BenillaOptionsFrame:IsVisible() end
-- `UIParent.lua:996`: a yes keeps the ESC sweep off the centre panel, which our window is. function IsOptionFrameOpen() if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then return 1 end return Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen() end
-- `UIParent.lua:1465-1497`: static popup, then an open options window, then the stock -- ladder. Our Close click is the discard-and-hide of the reference's `OptionsFrameCancel`. function ToggleGameMenu(clicked) if clicked then -- As the reference's `clicked` arm: close an options window, then toggle. if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end if StaticPopup_EscapePressed() then return end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() return end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end
-- `MainMenuBarMicroButtons.lua:47-58`: only ever pushes the button, so the stock decision -- stands and ours adds our window. Guarded for a test kit that loads no micro buttons. function UpdateMicroButtons() if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then Ref_UpdateMicroButtons() end if MainMenuMicroButton and BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then MainMenuMicroButton:SetButtonState("PUSHED", 1) end end
